CustomField.description: Who the email is sent from. The values are the EmailService.Sender enum names: NO_REPLY (org-wide address of label EmailService_DefaultOrgWideAddress), CURRENT_USER (the running user) or ORG_WIDE (the Org-Wide Address field).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: No Reply = the Salesforce no-reply address. Current User = the user running the Flow (Automated Process for scheduled Flows). Org-Wide Address = the address set in Org-Wide Address.
CustomField.label: Sender
